title: Acceptance evaluation is refused before judgment (committed_input_no_eligible_run) when the newest run on the named root's HEAD failed only outside the item's scope
outcome: Either the evaluation preflight admits an independent judgment whose criterion evidence explicitly discloses a known out-of-scope failure in the newest terminal run, or the refusal and the docs state that a passing eligible run on the exact HEAD is always required, so agents stop spending windows on evaluations that cannot be admitted.
acceptance: Acceptance evaluation is refused before judgment (committed_input_no_eligible_run) when the newest run on the named root's HEAD failed only outside the item's scope is done
